title: Practice 4: Two verbs for every way of going

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Он хорошо ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) верхом.
exercises.why: Ходить, ездить: these two verbs belong to the 2nd (И) type of conjugation. — DLI, Lesson 22.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: He is good at riding a horse.
exercises.context: Ходить, ездить: these two verbs belong to the 2nd (И) type of conjugation.

exercises.q: Летом я часто ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general) на дачу.
exercises.why: However each action of going (to go on foot, to ride, to fly) is expressed in Russian by two parallel verbs: one for the function A — being on the way to … — иду, еду, лечу; another for the function B — usually, often, etc. to go to … (the motion to and from is understood) — хожу, езжу, летаю. *Капитан идёт в штаб. Капитан едет в город. Капитан летит в Вашингтон.* — DLI, Lesson 22.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: In the summer, I often go to my country house.

exercises.q: И ___ (лететь — to fly, one way) чашка.
exercises.why: Капитан летит в Вашингтон.* The verb идти means "to go, be going". It refers to going on foot. This verb belongs to the 1st conjugation (characterized by the vowel -ё-, like живу, -ёшь, -ёт …). The verb ехать refers to going by some means of transportation, i.e. riding, driving: Я еду на поезде. (Я иду пешком.) Я еду в Европу. (Я иду в комнату.) This verb belongs to the 1st (Е) type of conjugation. Note. — The motion of a vehicle is expressed by идёт (not едет) when time-table and regular route are involved: Куда идёт этот автобус?* — DLI, Lesson 22.  ·  From Аркадий Гайдар, «Голубая чашка».
exercises.context: Капитан летит в Вашингтон.

exercises.q: А, ты ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way)?
exercises.why: They are used after the verb идти. *Где он был? — Он был здесь, там, дома.* — DLI, Lessons 19–20.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Вишнёвый сад».
exercises.context: They are used after the verb идти.

exercises.why: The corresponding question is куда: Куда они идут? Они идут в школу. — DLI, Lessons 19–20.  ·  From Алексей К. Толстой, «Царь Фёдор Иоаннович».
exercises.context: The corresponding question is куда: Куда они идут?
